title: RecruitClean: AI-Ready Candidate CSV Deduplicator & Scoring Engine
target_pain: Recruiting agencies and HR teams waste hours manually cleaning messy candidate CSVs, fixing broken email characters (like spaces around '@' or smart quotes), removing duplicate profiles, and scoring candidates against job descriptions.
key_features: Smart Character Sanitizer: Fixes broken '@' symbols, smart quotes, and hidden control characters
Fuzzy & Exact Deduplicator: Merges duplicates by normalized email, phone, or name
Weighted Keyword Scoring: Instantly scores candidates based on custom skill weights
Interactive Cleaned Table: Search, filter, and inspect cleaned candidate profiles
Instant Export: Download perfectly formatted CSV or JSON ready for your ATS or AI screening tools
